# Xquik

> Xquik is an independent third-party service. Not affiliated with X Corp. "Twitter" and "X" are trademarks of X Corp.

Use Xquik for public X data and connected-account actions. Choose REST, webhooks, SDKs, CLI tools, or MCP. API MCP at `https://xquik.com/mcp` supports MCP 2026-07-28. Search docs through `https://docs.xquik.com/mcp`. Install the public Skill with `npx skills add Xquik-dev/x-twitter-scraper`.

- [Documentation home](https://docs.xquik.com)
